source.label: Marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki: Beast (Henry McCoy) (archived 29 June 2018)

powerOrigins.detail: Born a mutant with an enhanced physique, outsized hands and feet, and great strength and agility.
At the Brand Corporation he took a hormonal extract he had isolated, which gave him a furry, bestial form that became permanent.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Amazing Adventures Vol 2 11

abilities.name: Genius intellect
abilities.detail: Holds six doctorates and is counted among the smartest people on Earth, expert in genetics, biochemistry and electronics.

abilities.name: Superhuman strength
abilities.detail: Can lift about 10 tons in his blue form, enough to smash a brick wall with a punch or knot an iron barbell.

abilities.name: Superhuman agility
abilities.detail: Combines the agility of a great ape with Olympic gymnastic skill, leaping 32 feet high and walking tightropes with ease.

abilities.name: Speed, stamina and durability
abilities.detail: Runs up to about 40 mph on all fours, works at peak for hours, and shrugs off blows from Colossus or the Hulk.

abilities.name: Healing and resistances
abilities.detail: Heals mild to moderate injuries within hours and resists cold, poisons, tranquilizers and some telepathic control.

abilities.name: Superhuman senses
abilities.detail: Sees and hears beyond human range, tracks by scent, has cat-like night vision and can feel electronic signals through walls.

abilities.name: Claws, fangs and dexterity
abilities.detail: Three-inch retractable claws and sharp fangs, and such dexterity he can write with both hands at once or tie knots with his toes.

abilities.name: Hand-to-hand combat
abilities.detail: Trained by Xavier and Captain America, he fights in a bouncing freestyle that makes full use of his strength and agility.

feats.text: Drank his own mutation serum to stop a lab theft, gaining fur, strength, agility and healing; missing the antidote window made the change permanent.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Amazing Adventures Vol 2 11

feats.text: Combined Moira MacTaggert's notes with his own research to finish a cure for the Legacy Virus, released when Colossus gave his life.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Uncanny X-Men Vol 1 390

feats.text: Used the Time Platform to bring the original five teenage X-Men from the past into the present, hoping they could change Cyclops' course.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: All-New X-Men Vol 1 1

feats.text: Back in his old uniform, he fought Magneto's army on Alcatraz in a savage, roaring style and injected Magneto with the cure, stripping his powers.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: X-Men: The Last Stand

feats.text: Examined Monica Rambeau after Binary found her adrift and worked out that she had fallen through a tear in space-time from a parallel reality.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: The Marvels
